name: Taqueria el chilango LLC
address: 765 Beal Pkwy NW, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32547

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Pedro De Los Santos
reviewSamples.text: Don't sleep on this place. Had a campechano torta and horchata and both were amazing. Will definitely be going back to try the tacos.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Marcella Vargas
reviewSamples.text: If you’re wanting some good authentic street tacos, this is the spot! The owner is so generous with his portions. Menudo and caldo de res is every Sunday. Typically open by 9ish. The only place that I know of with juicy tender lengua tacos. …
